title: trackerUnattendedHold
responsibility: Say why the launcher must not start a Tracker item by itself, with the same rules for the launcher and Hub Home.

inputs.name: trackerNonWorkAgent.agent
inputs.description: The agent value of an item, or nothing.

inputs.name: trackerUnattendedHold.title
inputs.description: The item title, checked for deploy, reminder and decision wording.

inputs.name: trackerUnattendedHold.owner
inputs.description: The item owner; Daniel as owner holds the launch. May be omitted or null.

inputs.name: trackerUnattendedHold.agent
inputs.description: The agent value; personal and Chief of Staff agents are held. May be omitted or null.

outputs.name: trackerNonWorkAgent
outputs.description: True for personal, family, brainstorming and Chief of Staff agents.

outputs.name: trackerReminderTitle
outputs.description: True when the title reads as a reminder or watch item.

outputs.name: trackerUnattendedHold
outputs.description: The reason the launcher holds the item, or null when it may start.
